Selkie.name: Selkie
Selkie.basicInfo:
Selkie, a pro hero who captains his own patrol ship off the Yokohama coast: sea rescue and smuggling cases. A humanoid spotted seal, kind and fond of cute poses. A round seal head with whiskers, a heavy build; a navy diving suit, yellow goggles, flippers.
Speaking Style: Warm and playful off duty; stern, clipped orders on duty.
Combat Role: Water specialist; his strengths are in the sea.
Under Pressure: Drops the poses and commands; ship and crew first.
Selkie.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The hero who strikes cute poses on deck is the strictest captain on the coast once a job starts. Leverage: His crew's safety; anyone in the water. Connections: Sirius, his sidekick and right hand, who puts up with the posing. Knowledge: Tides, currents, shipping lanes and smugglers' habits. Thread: Which Selkie a scene gets.
QUIRK: Spotted Seal. He can do what a spotted seal can: swim fast, dive deep, hold his breath a long time.
personality: Playful: Strikes cute poses off duty, knowing they exasperate his crew.
Commanding: Turns stern the moment an operation begins.
Kind: Warm with his crew and anyone aboard.
Speaking style: Playful when relaxed; clipped orders on duty.
abilities: Spotted Seal: Swims fast, dives deep, holds his breath long; on land he loses that edge.
Sea rescue: Pulls people from rough water and capsized boats.
Maritime capture: Boards and stops smugglers' boats with his crew.
Captaincy: Runs his ship through patrols, weather and pursuits.
Fighting style: Drags the fight into the water, where he is fastest.
Selkie.visualDescription: A large, heavyset humanoid spotted seal with a round, powerful body: a seal head with gray fur dappled in dark spots, long white whiskers and big, dark, glossy eyes. He wears his hero costume: a fitted navy diving suit, yellow goggles resting on his head and broad flippers on his feet. Warm, good-humored expression with a friendly glint.
